title: OPITZ form code (digits 1-5) - course table

provenance.transcribed_from: coding/manual_opitz.pdf, PDF page 5, 'Figure 6: OPITZ code Table provided in the APSD26 class material'
provenance.original_source: Course slides 'APSD.Part 02. CAPPCAM.pdf' (CO-581-B PART02, Fall 2026), OPITZ table on the slide footed 'Page 36' (same table repeated on 'Page 39'); table credited there to Radhakrishnan, Subramanian & Raju, CAD/CAM/CIM, 3rd ed., 2005
provenance.transcription: row texts copied as printed, including wording such as 'Operating Speed'; nothing added
provenance.pipeline_author_cross_check: 2026-11-11: every d1-d5 row compared with the slide footed 'Page 36' - all rows match.
other_tables_in_the_same_deck: Slide footed 'Page 31' (overview diagram): d1 shows 'L/D>=3' for class 2, gives class 3 'With Deviation L/D<=2', class 4 'With Deviation L/D>2', class 5 'Special', and puts rotational parts at 0-5 / nonrotational at 6-9 (the Page 36 table leaves rows 3-4 blank and labels 5-9 non rotational).
Slide footed 'Page 61': the classic OPITZ form-code table with different digit meanings (e.g. digit 3 'Rotational machining', digit 5 'Auxiliary hole(s), gear teeth, forming').
This file follows the Page 36 table, which is the table used in the team's frozen manual worksheet. Which table the instructor expects is a team/instructor decision, not resolved here.

sequence_definition: d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 = form code; d6-d9 = supplementary code (size, material, initial stock form, accuracy); ABCD = optional secondary operation code (brief Part 00 P1, section 1.5.1). Only d1-d5 are requested from the AI.
